notes:
Summary: Finoryx is a wealth & strategy research group inside a mid-to-large institutional asset manager. They want a production-grade semantic search and reranking layer to replace a slow, expensive ElasticSearch + homegrown reranker. Prefers dedicated capacity (predictable latency) and strict Canadian data residency. KMS must be customer-managed; audit logs + SSO required.

Key quotes / call snippets:
- 'Latency variability is our top blocker for enterprise adoption' (Head of Research).
- 'We need burn-rate predictability more than lowest per-token cost' (Procurement).

Technical priorities / constraints:
- Indexing scale: ~40-60M documents (PDFs, research notes, filings), average doc length 1.2k tokens, want incremental ingest + daily refresh cadence.
- Embeddings: prefer 1536-d or 1024-d open-medium models; want ability to test Open/quantized variants for cost tradeoffs.
- Reranking: lightweight cross-encoder style reranker for top-100 candidates; target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for rerank within dedicated pool at 50 concurrent queries.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost/query < $0.015 (embeddings + rerank combined) for 200k queries/month; willing to pay premium for SLA and data controls.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller quantized model during burst; prefer policy-based routing by latency SLA and model quality.

Operational asks:
- Customer-managed KMS (HSM integration if possible) and key rotation logs.
- Audit trail retention 12 months, ability to forward logs to their Splunk instance.
- VPC peering with strict egress policies; on-prem gateway option for air-gapped retrieval of sensitive filings.

Deals / commercial notes:
- Procurement is leaning toward a 12-month committed Dedicated pool + Optimize bundle if POC meets latency/cost targets.
- Procurement requested a conservative TCO model showing dedicated vs hosted for their 50M doc baseline.

Stated next steps (short):
- Run 2-week POC: ingest 5-10M sample docs, benchmark embedding compute and reranker latency; validate KMS flow.
- Deliver sizing/pricing workbook and draft DPA with Canadian residency clause.
requirements_summary: POC scope and acceptance criteria: ingest 5-10M representative docs and run full RAG pipeline. Acceptance: p50 rerank < 120ms, p95 rerank < 350ms at 50 concurrent QPS; end-to-end query RTT (embedding search + rerank + payload) < 600ms for single-turn chat; cost estimate showing <= $0.015/query at 200k monthly queries. Must demonstrate VPC connectivity and customer-managed KMS with key rotation logs. Provide fallback policy that routes to quantized model with <10% quality regression on top-10 rerank accuracy.
